page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.6xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 3.1 GHz. It features 24 physical cores with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, providing 24 dedicated vCPUs without hyperthreading. The instance is configured with 96.0 GB of RAM, yielding a resource density of 4.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU hardware, relying on network-attached storage and featuring a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps.

Benchmark results place the instance in the average tier across multiple performance metrics. The Intel Xeon processor achieves a stress-ng single-core score of 1438.39 and a multi-core score of 23015.19, supported by AVX-512 vector extensions. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 1282.13 GB/sec, which drops to 109.43 GB/sec for large uncached blocks, and a write speed of 48.03 GB/sec. In application-specific benchmarks, the server handles 22.14 million Redis SET operations per second and achieves a static web serving throughput of 17.13 GB/sec. For small-scale language models, prompt processing reaches 1294.61 tokens per second on a 135M parameter model.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation ensures predictable compute performance without resource contention, though the lack of local storage requires additional network storage resources. The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offers a balanced profile for general-purpose workloads. This instance is suitable for multi-threaded applications, software compilation, database operations, and web serving.
